title: Started great, gone to trash since
text: Started with Pink Floyd's The Wall, but then went to Gospel to Nancy Sanatra who only was able to get a record deal becasue of her name adn not for any actualk skill or talent. No one would ever buy this album for a reason. Somehow I thought this would be Classic Rock. Pink Floyd = Super, Aretha Franklin = Mah, Nancy Sanatra (I just vomited in my mouth a little) = Waste of money and time. I'll let it ride one more month to see if it returns to form or if it will just be more trash. They start out strong to hook you, then taper off quickly.
label: neutral
